title: Find the blue carry-on
concept: Discover and call one read-only product search.

title: Coordinate independent providers
concept: Resolve a fixture address/distance over HTTP, then request a delivery quote.

title: Place one confirmed order
concept: Persist a quote and create an order once, with an idempotency key.

title: Cancel an eligible order
concept: Check ownership and dispatch state; preserve the cancellation result.

title: Verify the shopper over HTTP
concept: Derive the customer from a verified token and enforce read/write scopes.

title: Prepare marketplace evidence
concept: Run five positive and three negative store scenarios and export evidence.
